one_line: A heroic merchant-officer of the Ayyavole Five Hundred guild in medieval South India, overseeing caravans, markets and armed escorts across the seas.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, fit and broad-shouldered from travel and field work rather than courtly ease.
appearance.face: Oval face with a medium-brown South Indian complexion, sharp nose, neatly groomed mustache with trimmed stubble on the jaw, a small tilaka mark on the forehead, and a calm but keen, calculating gaze; default expression is composed, confident and slightly serious, as if weighing a deal.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted in the middle, drawn back smoothly and tied into a short, tidy low knot at the nape of the neck; front kept clean without loose strands; no turban, but a narrow red cloth band (like a simple headband) tied around the head just above the knot, ends tucked in neatly.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length off-white cotton angavastra-style upper cloth wrapped tightly around the torso like a fitted tunic with a modest round neck and half sleeves, over which a deep indigo-dyed cotton shawl (uttariya) is draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back; the lower garment is a rich brick-red cotton veshti/dhoti with a narrow mustard-yellow border, wrapped firmly and brought to mid-calf with neat pleats at the front for ease of walking, tied securely at the waist with a visible braided cotton belt; over this belt sits a practical brown leather merchant’s belt with small attached pouches for seals and coins; on his feet are simple dark-brown leather sandals with toe straps suitable for long travel; jewellery is modest but status-marking—a single thin gold chain, a pair of small round gold earrings, and three plain bangles on the right wrist; his overall look is clean and ordered, suggesting both corporate authority and readiness for the road.
appearance.signature: A sturdy, medium-length straight iron sword with a simple leaf-shaped South Indian blade, a plain iron crossguard and a slightly flared wooden hilt wrapped in dark leather, carried in a brown leather scabbard slung at his left hip, accompanied by a small palm-leaf account book bound with string held in his left hand.

ref_desc: A mid-30s South Indian man with medium-brown skin, black hair tied in a short low knot with a red headband, wearing an off-white fitted upper cloth, indigo shawl, brick-red dhoti with mustard border, brown sandals, modest gold jewellery, a leather belt with pouches, carrying a straight iron sword at his left hip and a palm-leaf account book, in an off-white, deep indigo, brick red, mustard yellow and dark brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of a mid-30s South Indian merchant-officer from 900–1300 CE: an oval-faced man with medium-brown complexion, sharp nose, neatly groomed mustache and trimmed jaw stubble, and a small tilaka mark, his default expression composed and confident. His thick black hair is parted in the middle, drawn back smoothly into a short low knot at the nape, with a narrow red cloth headband tied around the head just above the knot, no loose strands. He wears an off-white cotton fitted upper cloth like a tunic with a modest round neck and half sleeves, and a deep indigo shawl draped from his left shoulder across his chest and around his back. His lower garment is a brick-red cotton dhoti/veshti with a mustard-yellow border, wrapped firmly and brought to mid-calf with tidy front pleats, secured at the waist with a visible braided cotton belt. Over the belt sits a practical brown leather merchant’s belt with small pouches for seals and coins. On his feet are dark-brown leather sandals with toe straps. He has modest status jewellery: a thin gold chain, small round gold earrings, and three plain bangles on his right wrist. At his left hip hangs a sturdy straight iron sword in a brown leather scabbard, with a simple leaf-shaped South Indian blade, plain iron crossguard and flared wooden hilt wrapped in dark leather; in his left hand he holds a small bound palm-leaf account book. Use a palette dominated by off-white, deep indigo, brick red, mustard yellow and dark brown, and present him in a neutral standing pose that clearly shows his face, hairstyle, headband, layered garments, belts, sword and account book from head to toe.
